# AI Chat Page - Development Plan

## Design
- Color Palette: Dark theme with #1a1a2e (background), #16213e (chat area), #0f3460 (user message), #e94560 (accent/send button), #ffffff (text)
- Typography: Inter font, clean and modern
- Layout: Full-height chat interface with message list and bottom input bar

## Development Tasks
- [x] Create chat page component with message list and input area
- [x] Integrate Atoms Cloud AI (claude-opus-4.6) with streaming response
- [x] Style the chat interface with dark theme and smooth animations

# AI Chat Page - Development Plan

## Design
- Color Palette: Dark theme with #1a1a2e (background), #16213e (chat area), #0f3460 (user message), #e94560 (accent/send button), #ffffff (text)
- Typography: Inter font, clean and modern
- Layout: Full-height chat interface with message list and bottom input bar

## Development Tasks
- [x] Create chat page component with message list and input area
- [x] Integrate Atoms Cloud AI (claude-opus-4.6) with streaming response
- [x] Style the chat interface with dark theme and smooth animations
